stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 1 & 6 - the handicapper has questions

stories.title: Leading the Way
stories.detail: Colin Cummins out front at 21 pts - the ladder leaders the handicapper warned us about

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome to Wagga Wagga Country Club, Shane Evans - great to have Wagga City GC with us today. Enjoy your round.

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 4 twos on holes 5-8 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Steady Eddie
stories.detail: 6 two-pointers, not a wipe in sight - metronomic golf

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 4 twos on the bounce on holes 4-7

stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 3 & 4 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: Bounce-Back Merchant
stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 3 & 4 - the course charges a fee for everything
